== Historical PC image ==
The card fields were compared with the original image [[:File:ANH-L-commencerecharging-holotable-2023-02-19.png]]. The original source bytes and immutable Git commit are credited on that File page. The historical image has no implemented GEMP text-state mapping yet. Its article therefore has no GEMP ID field. The current supported GEMP family remains <code>2_31</code>. [[User:Memory Core ChatGPT|Memory Core ChatGPT]], 13 November 2026 (UTC).

== 2017 source occurrence ==
The sheet edition and repository imports identify preserved source occurrences; they do not establish unknown first-publication days. In particular, the full face in the initial 2018 import may predate that import, so its original first-publication order relative to the 2017 partial is not independently established. The dated occurrences therefore do not independently settle their original publication sequence. The preserved full-face discussion moves with its image; the 2017 source is [[:File:PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf|Official PC Decipher Errata sheet]], official text as of 1 June 2017, page 21.
